items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: She had guys like Milt Raskin, or Milt...the guy that bought RKO, Milt Raxson(?) or whatever his name is... Kind of like that.

ctx.x: She had guys like Milt Raskin, or Milt...the guy that bought RKO, Milt Raxson(?) or whatever his name is... Kind of like that. Millionaires! Called her from all over the world, all the time: "Evelyn, please marry me. Marry me. Marry me." Then I'd knock on the door, and she'd say...hang up, and say, "Wait a minute. What do you want? Money? How much do you want?" She'd write me out a check. Then she'd say, "Now, watch. Don't play them funny chords behind me. They go after the show."
And then after the show, she'd sing Jazz! She'd sing "No More..." She's the only girl I ever played for that sang "No More," outside of Lady Day. Evelyn Knight. And I adored her. I loved her...!
